confirmed_decisions.question: What is the full selling-unit name for the source unit code 'BT' used on every material in sheet 'Sales units'?

evidence: Workbook has two sheets: 'Material' (Material code, Description) 12 rows, and 'Sales units' (Material code, Unit code) 12 rows.
Documented join Material->Sales units on 'Material code' is complete and 1:1 (12 matched, 0 duplicates, 0 unmatched on either side).
'Material code' carries zero-padded identifiers (000001 … 000012); mapped as text, not number.
'Unit code' holds the single value 'BT' in all 12 rows; no code-to-name table exists in the workbook.
Header 'Material code' in sheet 'Material'; 12 distinct values, null_ratio 0.0, unique_ratio 1.0
Zero-padded samples 000001, 000002, 000011, 000012 — cast to text so leading zeros survive
Target /sku: 'Unique SKU identifier; preserve leading zeros.'
Only descriptive text column in the product master: 'Description' with 12 distinct values ('Coffee variant 01', 'Soap variant 11', 'Shampoo variant 02', 'Tea variant 12')
Target /product_name: 'Product name from the master list.'; values kept verbatim, including the 'variant NN' suffix

fields.note: 'BT' is an unexplained abbreviation; clarification requests the full selling-unit name.
evidence: Sheet 'Sales units' column 'Unit code' holds 'BT' in all 12 rows; joined 1:1 to the product master on 'Material code'
Workbook contains no code-to-name table expanding 'BT', and the operator requirements state the meaning of BT has not been specified
Value kept verbatim; no unit_normalize/guess applied because target says codes require source evidence or human confirmation
Confirmed by operator in question review
